headline: Philippine Unemployment Rises as Labor Force Expands
summary: Unemployment in the Philippines rose in September as a larger number of individuals entered the labor force despite overall employment gains.
why: Monthly labor force statistics are key economic indicators tracking employment trends and labor market health.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: National unemployment rate increased in September due to labor force expansion.
